subject: Evidence: SCIM deprovisioning window & delegated-admin scope for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@meridianhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: IT Compliance <it-compliance@meridianhealth.com>, security@meridianhealth.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Proof of SCIM deprovisioning & delegated-admin scopes for upcoming SOC2

Hi Jonas / Laura,

We're opening our SOC 2 readiness review and need a small bundle of evidence around identity lifecycle and delegated administration for the Redwood integration. The audit kickoff is 2025-08-01, so we're hoping to receive the artifacts by 2025-07-25 if possible. Specifically we need: 

- A SCIM delta export showing user deprovisioning events for the last 6 months (include timestamps for deprovision event and the corresponding account termination in Redwood).
- Evidence that deprovisioning is performed within your stated SLA (we need a sample of latency measurements and a short summary of median/95th percentile).
- A sample SAML assertion (no PII) used during user provisioning or login that includes NameID format and attribute mappings for email/uid.
- A current RBAC/role mapping snapshot (roles -> permissions) for Meridian's tenant and an explanation of any delegated-admin scopes.
- Confirmation of retention windows for provisioning logs and SCIM deltas (where they live, how long retained).

We're happy with redacted exports (remove PHI/SSNs). If you can provide a short note on how delegated-admin privileges are scoped (what actions a delegated admin can perform and whether they can create/delete service accounts), that would be excellent.

Thanks — let me know if you need more time.

Regards,
Alice Park
Senior Information Security Manager
Meridian Health

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.coale@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of SCIM deprovisioning & delegated-admin scopes for upcoming SOC2

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the package and aim to deliver by 2025-07-25. Quick notes and asks from our side: 

- We will provide a SCIM delta CSV covering Jan–Jul 2025 with timestamps for SCIM "remove" events and the corresponding internal account state change. We will redact any PHI.
- I'll include a deprovisioning metrics summary (median and 95th percentiles) and a short explanation of how our SCIM worker and async deprovision pipeline works.
- We'll attach a sanitized SAML assertion sample and a role mapping file.
- On delegated-admin scope: we'll include a short policy doc and an exported role description showing what delegated admins can/cannot do.
- Please confirm whether you want full raw logs or redacted samples and whether CSV format is acceptable for the SCIM delta.

Marissa — can you pull the last 6 months of SCIM delta and produce the deprovisioning metrics? Rishi — please add a brief (1-pg) note on delegated-admin scope and retention for SCIM logs. Laura — can you review before we send?

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: marissa.coale@redwood.ai <marissa.coale@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Proof of SCIM deprovisioning & delegated-admin scopes for upcoming SOC2

On Thu, Jul 17, 2025 at 11:03 AM jonas.weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Marissa — can you pull the last 6 months of SCIM delta and produce the deprovisioning metrics?

Got it — pulling SCIM deltas now. Plan:
- Export SCIM delta events for Meridian Health tenant from 2025-01-01 to 2025-07-17 as CSV. 
- Produce a metrics summary (median, mean, 90th and 95th percentiles) for time between SCIM "delete" event and Redwood account disabled state.
- Generate a role mapping snapshot (csv) of current roles assigned in the tenant.

Estimated delivery: 2 business days. One question: do we want to include raw OIDC/SAML messages for every login? I recommend supplying one sanitized SAML assertion sample and not full login traces. Also: will Meridian want the full log store export (large) or a 90-day slice? They asked for "last 6 months" for SCIM deltas; logs retention is 12 months in our system by default.

Marissa Coale
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.coale@redwood.ai

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.coale@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, IT Compliance <it-compliance@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian evidence package — SCIM deprovisioning, SAML, RBAC (deliverables)

Hi Alice — thanks for the patience. Attached is the evidence package we discussed. Summary below and notes on redaction and formats.

Attachments (zipped):
- scim_delta_export_202501-202507.csv — CSV of SCIM events (types: timestamp, event_type, external_id, internal_user_id (redacted), reason_code). PHI removed.
- saml_assertion_sample_jul2025.txt — single sanitized SAML response sample showing NameID and attribute mapping (email, uid, groups). No PII.
- rbac_role_mapping_snapshot_20250719.csv — current role -> permission mapping for Meridian tenant (human-readable role descriptions).
- deprovisioning_metrics_summary_20250719.pdf — one-page summary: median time to disable account = 12 minutes; 90th = 36 minutes; 95th = 47 minutes. Methodology described on page 1.

Key clarifications:
- We performed redaction of internal_user_id values to a hashed identifier. We removed any free-text fields that could contain PHI.
- Retention: SCIM delta exports and provisioning logs are retained for 12 months in the internal audit bucket. Raw login traces are kept for 90 days.
- Delegated-admin scope: delegated admins in your tenant have the following limited capabilities: invite users, assign tenant-scoped roles, and view usage dashboards. Delegated admins cannot create or manage platform-level service accounts, cannot escalate to account owners, and do not have access to raw audit logs. See attached rbac_role_mapping_snapshot_20250719.csv for the exact permissions.

If you need the raw log export or a longer retention export, we can schedule that as an additional deliverable (may require a short workback due to size). We can also walk through the package in a quick screen-share next week.

Links: HubSpot deal MD-4782 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/MD-4782) and Drive folder with the evidence (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMeridian-Evidence-2025).

Please confirm receipt and whether the redaction is acceptable for your auditor. Happy to make adjustments.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
